# **File Conversion (HET_IMPORT, HET_EXPORT, PVLOOK, PV_EXPORT, PV_IMPORT, SDIF2AD, SRC_CONV)**

The following utilities exist for file conversion:

* [HET_EXPORT](../het_export): Exports a .het (produced by [HETRO](../hetro)) to a comma separated text file.
* [HET_IMPORT](../het_import): Generates a .het (in the format produced by [HETRO](../hetro)) from a comma separated text file for usage with the [adsyn](../../opcodes/adsyn) generator.
* [PVLOOK](../pvlook): View formatted text output of STFT analysis files.
* [PV_EXPORT](../pv_export): Converts a file generated by [PVANAL](../pvanal) to a text file.
* [PV_IMPORT](../pv_import): Converts a text file (in the format generated by [PV_EXPORT](../pv_export)) to a [PVANAL](../pvanal) format file to be used with the [pvoc](../../opcodes/pvoc) opcode.
* [SDIF2AD](../sdif2ad): Converts SDIF files to files usable by adsynt.
* [SRC_CONV](../src_conv): Converts the sample rate of an audio file.
